Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the cell wall as a structure common to both plant and animal cells. In standard biology, the cell wall is exclusive to plant cells (and some fungi/bacteria), whereas animal cells lack a cell wall and instead have an extracellular matrix. Additionally, the Planner claimed mitochondria are not universal to animal cells due to red blood cells, ignoring that the question asks for structures common to the *types* of cells in general, where mitochondria are a defining feature of eukaryotic cells (including animal cells), unlike chloroplasts or cell walls. This fundamental factual error led to the selection of option C instead of the correct option B.
